create.stepPathTitle: How do you want to start?
create.pathRecoverDesc: Enter a seed you already have.
create.presetHint: Normal is recommended. Paranoid uses more memory and unlocks slower.
create.wipeHint: Destroys local encrypted data after 10 wrong passwords. Seed recovery is the only way back.

unlock.title: Unlock vault
unlock.subtitle: Enter your password to decrypt local data.

shell.emptyPortfolios: No portfolios yet. Scan a seed or sync your Trezor.
shell.homeBody: Vault is unlocked. Create or restore a seed to start holding funds.
shell.homeBodyReady: Seed ready. Add software, Trezor, or watch-only portfolios from the sidebar.
shell.totalNoteReady: {{count}} portfolio(s) · values use live prices when available
shell.totalNoteNoSeed: Set up a seed before creating software wallets
shell.nextDesc: Finish these steps so you can hold and move funds safely.
shell.stepSeedNeed: Create or restore a BIP39 seed. This is how you recover software wallets.
shell.stepSeedBackup: Seed is stored — confirm you wrote it down offline.
shell.stepSeedDone: Seed is set and marked backed up.
shell.stepPortfolioDesc: Each portfolio is one chain (Bitcoin, Ethereum, etc.) — software, Trezor, or watch-only.
shell.stepTrezorDesc: Install Trezor Bridge and plug in a device if you want hardware signing.
shell.summaryDesc: Open a row for balances, receive, send, and history.

seed.stepPathTitle: How do you want to start?
seed.writeDown: Write these words offline. Never share them.
seed.confirmed: I have backed up my seed
seed.passphraseHint: Only if your original wallet used a 25th-word passphrase. Leave blank if not.
seed.restoreWordCount: Enter a valid 12 or 24-word seed phrase.

portfolio.name: Name
portfolio.addHint: Choose a network, how you hold keys, then fill in the details.
portfolio.chainHint: Each portfolio is scoped to one chain.
portfolio.kindSoftwareHint: Keys derived from your vault seed. You can send from this app.
portfolio.kindTrezorHint: Keys stay on the device. Confirm addresses and sends on the Trezor screen.
portfolio.kindWatchHint: Track balances only. You cannot send from a watch portfolio.
portfolio.watchHint: EVM addresses require picking the network first.
portfolio.trezorAddressHint: Paste the address after verifying it on your Trezor screen.
portfolio.addressTypeHint: Native SegWit is the default for most wallets.
portfolio.verifyOnDevice: Ask Trezor to show the address (optional)
portfolio.verifyOnDeviceHint: Uses the Verify button below. Save always reads the address silently — the same way Sync works.
portfolio.trezorNoSendHint: Sending isn't wired up for this network yet — you'll be able to receive and track balances, but use Trezor Suite to send.
portfolio.trezorNoAutoVerifyHint: This network isn't supported for on-device address verification yet. Derive the address elsewhere (e.g. Trezor Suite) and paste it below.
portfolio.balancesHint: What this portfolio holds right now.
portfolio.noBalances: No balances yet. Use Receive to get an address.
portfolio.spendSoftware: You can send from this portfolio with your seed.
portfolio.spendTrezor: Sending requires your Trezor to confirm on-device.
portfolio.spendTrezorDisconnected: Plug in and unlock your Trezor to send from this wallet.
portfolio.spendTrezorUnsupported: Sending isn't wired up for this network yet — use Trezor Suite to send.
portfolio.spendTonUnsupported: Gram sending isn't wired up yet — receive and balances work; use TON Keeper to send for now.
portfolio.spendWatch: Watch — you can see balances but cannot send.
portfolio.sendAmountHint: How much do you want to send?
portfolio.sendAddressOk: Address looks valid for this network.
portfolio.sendExceedsBalance: Amount is more than your available balance.
portfolio.reviewHint: Double-check the prefix and suffix of the destination address.
portfolio.noHistoryHint: Incoming and outgoing activity will show up here.
portfolio.historyError: Couldn't load transactions from the network. Try again in a moment.

swap.title: Swap
swap.subtitle: Trade one asset in your wallet for another.
swap.routePartner: Finishes on {{partner}} — Opal only shows the rate.
swap.partnerNote: {{partner}} finishes this trade. Add API keys in Settings to create and send the deposit from Opal.
swap.disclaimer: Swap services are available through third-party API providers.
swap.needAddress: This portfolio has no address yet — open it once, then come back.
swap.overBalance: Amount is more than your balance.
swap.depositHint: Send the deposit to this address to complete the swap.
swap.depositSent: Deposit sent. FixedFloat will complete the swap after confirmations.
swap.swapSubmitted: Swap {{id}} submitted (tx {{txid}}…). FixedFloat will finish after confirmations.
swap.autoSubmitted: Deposit sent automatically. FixedFloat will credit your destination after network confirmations.
swap.oneClickNote: One click creates the FixedFloat order and sends the deposit from your wallet.
swap.needSoftware: Automated swaps need a software portfolio as the source.
swap.empty: Nothing to swap yet. Add a portfolio with a balance first.
swap.txReady: Transaction built. Signing from Opal isn't wired up yet — this is for reference only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bip39Hint: Optional 25th word for software seed. Lost passphrase means lost funds.
settings.wipeHint: Destroy the local vault after 10 wrong unlock attempts
settings.presetHint: Re-wraps the vault key. Requires your current password.
settings.fixedfloatHint: Required to create swaps inside Opal. Get a key at ff.io/api. Without keys, Opal still shows live rates and opens FixedFloat in your browser.
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Launch when you sign in to Windows
settings.notificationsHint: Notify on incoming transfers when available
settings.customRpcHint: Optional per-chain API base URLs. Leave blank for defaults.
settings.passwordSectionHint: Updates the password that unlocks this vault.
settings.passwordCurrentHint: Enter the password you use to unlock Opal.
settings.passwordNewHint: Choose a new unlock password (at least 8 characters).
settings.passwordConfirmHint: Type the new password again to confirm.
settings.vaultBackupHint: Export copies the encrypted vault file. Import replaces the local vault and locks the session.
settings.importDone: Vault imported. Unlock again if needed.
settings.wipeWalletHint: Permanently deletes this vault from this device so you can create or restore a new one. Your on-chain funds are not moved — keep your seed phrase if you still need them.
settings.wipeWalletPassword: Enter your unlock password to confirm
settings.wipeWalletDone: Wallet wiped. You can set up Opal from scratch.

errors.vault_wiped: Vault wiped after too many failed attempts.
errors.weak_password: Password must be at least 8 characters.

trezor.syncBody: Opal will ask your unlocked Trezor for addresses and add any wallets that already have balance or activity. Confirm prompts on the device if they appear.
trezor.syncHint: Supports Bitcoin, Ethereum & L2s, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, Tron, and Monero (Model T / Safe). Gram is not available on Trezor.
trezor.syncNone: No funded wallets found on this device
trezor.deviceMissing: Plug in and unlock your Trezor
